run_fine_tune_main: run the fine-tuning pipeline on a pretrained encoder with distributed training and checkpointing
load_pretrained_encoder: load a pretrained encoder state dict from a checkpoint file into a model
load_from_path_checkpoint: load encoder, optimizer, scheduler, and epoch state from a saved checkpoint path
init_model_with_optimizer: initialize a resnet or wide_resnet encoder with a projection head, optimizer, and scheduler
review_fine_tune_main: review the main fine-tuning loop that trains and validates a model across epochs
